docs.title: Install CB POS
docs.summary: How to download and install CB POS on Windows 10 or later using the 2-minute setup wizard.
docs.body_md:
# Install CB POS

CB POS runs on Windows 10 (64-bit) or Windows 11 as a standalone desktop application [A2]. It is completely offline-first and requires no internet connection to bill your customers [A2].

## System Requirements

- **Operating System:** Windows 10 (64-bit, version 1809 or later) or Windows 11 [A2]
- **Memory:** 4 GB RAM minimum (8 GB recommended for fast lookups with large item catalogs)
- **Storage:** 500 MB free disk space for the program and database

## Installation Steps

1. Download the installer `CBPOSSetup-1.3.0.exe` from the official Ceylon Byte website [A3].
2. Open the downloaded file to launch the setup wizard.
3. By default, CB POS installs into your user application directory (`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\CB POS`) [A4]. This means you do not need Windows Administrator privileges or UAC elevation to install and run the program [A4].
4. Follow the setup wizard prompts. Installation takes under two minutes on most computers.

:::callout{type=tip}
For POS technicians deploying CB POS across many stores, the installer supports Inno Setup silent flags: run `CBPOSSetup-1.3.0.exe /SILENT` or `/VERYSILENT` in PowerShell [A4].
:::

# CB POS ස්ථාපනය කිරීම

CB POS වින්ඩෝස් 10 හෝ ඊට පසු සංස්කරණවල ස්වාධීන මෘදුකාංගයක් ලෙස ක්‍රියාත්මක වේ [A2].

## අවශ්‍යතා

- වින්ඩෝස් 10 (64-bit) හෝ වින්ඩෝස් 11 [A2]
- 4 GB මතකය
- 500 MB නිදහස් ඉඩ

## ස්ථාපන පියවර

1. වෙබ් අඩවියෙන් `CBPOSSetup.exe` බාගත කරන්න [A3].
2. ස්ථාපන ගොනුව ක්‍රියාත්මක කරන්න.
3. මිනිත්තු 2ක සරල පියවර අනුගමනය කරන්න [A4].

docs.title: Get past Windows SmartScreen
docs.summary: Why Windows displays a blue 'Windows protected your PC' prompt and how to proceed safely.
docs.body_md:
# Get past Windows SmartScreen

When you run the CB POS installer on Windows 10 or 11, Microsoft Defender SmartScreen may display a blue dialog titled **"Windows protected your PC"** [A5].

## Why does this appear?

This is completely normal for new freeware software. Windows SmartScreen displays this alert on any executable that has not yet built up a cryptographic reputation via an EV code-signing certificate [A5]. Certified certificates cost upwards of $400 USD annually. As a 100% free community project, Ceylon Byte is currently raising funds through user donations to purchase an official code-signing certificate [A5].

## How to proceed

1. Click **"More info"** link on the SmartScreen dialog [A5].
2. Click the **"Run anyway"** button at the bottom [A5].

:::callout{type=tip}
You can verify that your installer has not been modified by checking its SHA-256 checksum in PowerShell:
```powershell
Get-FileHash .\CBPOSSetup-1.3.0.exe -Algorithm SHA256
```
The checksum must match the value published on our official Releases page.
:::

docs.title: First login and the default PIN
docs.summary: Logging into CB POS for the first time and changing the default administrator PIN.
docs.body_md:
# First login and the default PIN

When you open CB POS for the first time, the login screen prompts you for an employee PIN.

## Default Administrator Account

- **Default PIN:** `1234` [I1]
- **Role:** Administrator (Full Permissions)

## Changing Your PIN

For security, change the default administrator PIN before processing your first customer sale [I1]:

1. Log in with `1234` [I1].
2. Go to **Settings** › **Users & Security**.
3. Select the Administrator user profile.
4. Click **Change PIN**, type your new 4-digit to 6-digit numeric PIN, and save.
5. You can also create cashier profiles with restricted permissions (e.g., blocking price edits or refunds) [I1].

docs.title: Make your first sale
docs.summary: Walkthrough of cashiering workflow: searching items, adding to cart, and tendering payment.
docs.body_md:
# Make your first sale

CB POS is designed for fast, high-volume retail cashiering [B1]. You can operate the entire billing screen using just your keyboard or a barcode scanner.

## Step-by-Step Billing

1. **Scan or Search:** Scan an item's barcode, or press `F3` to search by product name or code [B1].
2. **Adjust Quantity:** Use `+` and `-` on your number pad to adjust item quantity, or type a quantity and press `*` [B1].
3. **Hold a Bill:** If a customer needs to pick another item, press `F6` to hold the bill, attend to the next customer, and press `F7` to recall the held bill [B1].
4. **Tender Payment:**
   - Press `F12` for **Quick Cash** (customer pays exact total amount) [B1].
   - Press `F5` to open the standard cash tender dialog, enter the cash amount received, and view the exact change owed [B1].
   - Press `F10` for split payment (e.g. part Cash, part Card or Credit Book) [B1].
5. **Receipt:** The thermal receipt prints automatically and the cash drawer kicks open [E1].

docs.title: Keyboard shortcuts
docs.summary: Complete keyboard keymap for mouse-free retail billing in CB POS.
docs.body_md:
# Keyboard shortcuts

CB POS is keyboard-first [B1]. Mastering these shortcuts lets your cashiers bill twice as fast during peak hours.

| Shortcut | Action | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `F3` | Item Search | Opens item search popup by name or SKU [B1] |
| `F5` | Tender / Pay | Opens payment dialog to enter cash received [B1] |
| `F10` | Split Payment | Pay with multiple methods (Cash, Card, Loyalty, Credit) [B1] |
| `F12` | Quick Cash | Completes bill immediately with exact cash [B1] |
| `F6` | Hold Bill | Holds current cart and clears screen for next customer [B1] |
| `F7` | Recall Bill | Restores previously held customer carts [B1] |
| `+` / `-` | Quantity | Increase or decrease quantity of selected line [B1] |
| `Delete` | Remove Line | Removes selected item from the current bill [B1] |
| `Esc` | Clear / Cancel | Clears search box or cancels current modal [B1] |
| `F8` | Loyalty / Customer | Looks up customer profile by mobile number [B2] |

:::callout{type=tip}
Print a physical copy for your cashiers using our [Printable Shortcuts Cheat Sheet](/docs/shortcuts/print) [B1].
:::

docs.title: Turn on VAT registration
docs.summary: Configuring VAT registration and tax rates for registered businesses.
docs.body_md:
# Turn on VAT registration

By default, CB POS bills products at their shelf MRP without separating tax components [C1]. If your business is registered for Value Added Tax (VAT) with the Inland Revenue Department (IRD), you can turn on VAT calculations in settings.

## How to Enable VAT

1. Open CB POS and navigate to **Settings** › **Business Profile** [C1].
2. Check the box labelled **"Business is VAT Registered"** [C1].
3. Enter your shop's official Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) and VAT registration number [C1].
4. Confirm the standard VAT rate (defaults to 18%) [C1].
5. Save your settings.

Once enabled, receipts and A4 tax invoices will display the mandatory tax breakdown and your TIN/VAT numbers [C1][C4].

docs.title: How VAT and SSCL are calculated
docs.summary: Understanding backward VAT from shelf MRP and Social Security Contribution Levy (SSCL) formulas.
docs.body_md:
# How VAT and SSCL are calculated

In Sri Lanka, retail prices on shelf items are maximum retail prices (MRP) inclusive of tax [C1]. CB POS automatically derives the base price, VAT, and SSCL backward from the shelf price so your cashiers do not need to do manual calculations [C1][C2].

## The Mathematical Formulas

When **Business is VAT Registered** is active [C1]:

1. **Base Price (VAT Exclusive):**
   $$\text{Base} = \frac{\text{MRP}}{1 + \text{VAT Rate}}$$
   At the standard 18% rate: `Base = MRP / 1.18` [C1].

2. **VAT Amount:**
   $$\text{VAT} = \text{MRP} - \text{Base}$$
   This guarantees that `Base + VAT` always exactly equals the shelf MRP [C1].

3. **SSCL Calculation:**
   Social Security Contribution Levy (SSCL) is calculated at 2.5% on 50% of the VAT-exclusive base [C2]:
   $$\text{SSCL} = \text{Base} \times 50\% \times 2.5\%$$

## Worked Example

For an item with shelf MRP of **Rs. 1,180.00** [C1][C2]:
- **Base Price:** Rs. 1,000.00
- **VAT (18%):** Rs. 180.00
- **SSCL (2.5% on 50% base):** Rs. 12.50
- **Customer Pays:** Rs. 1,180.00

docs.title: Connect a receipt printer
docs.summary: Setting up 58mm and 80mm ESC/POS thermal printers with Sinhala and Tamil printing support.
docs.body_md:
# Connect a receipt printer

CB POS supports standard 58mm and 80mm ESC/POS thermal printers connected via USB, Ethernet (LAN), or virtual Windows COM ports [E1].

## Setting up your printer

1. Plug your printer into your PC via USB and install the manufacturer's Windows printer driver [E1].
2. In CB POS, go to **Settings** › **Printers & Hardware** [E1].
3. Select your receipt paper width: **58mm** or **80mm** [E1].
4. Choose your printer from the Windows printer dropdown.
5. Click **Test Print** to verify receipt feed and cash drawer kick [E1].

## Sinhala and Tamil Receipt Printing

Standard thermal receipt printers do not have Sinhala or Tamil fonts built into their hardware ROM [E2]. CB POS solves this by rendering Sinhala and Tamil text as sharp monochrome bitmap graphics before sending them to the printer via ESC/POS raster graphics commands [E2]. This means you can print receipts in Sinhala or Tamil on any cheap standard thermal printer [E2]!

docs.title: Scale-label barcodes
docs.summary: Configuring 3-decimal weighing scale barcodes for loose grains and vegetables.
docs.body_md:
# Scale-label barcodes

For grocery stores, pharmacies, and mini-marts selling loose commodities (rice, dhal, sugar, vegetables), CB POS provides native support for 3-decimal weight quantities [D2] and barcode-printing scales [E3].

## Supported Barcode Standard

CB POS parses standard EAN-13 weight-embedded retail barcodes [E3]:

```
2 0 I I I I W W W W W C
```
- `20` or `21`: Standard retail prefix for variable-weight items [E3]
- `IIII`: 4-digit internal Item Code matching your product database [E3]
- `WWWWW`: 5-digit weight in grams (e.g., `01250` = 1.250 kg) [E3]
- `C`: Standard EAN checksum digit

## How Cashiering Works with Scales

When a cashier scans a scale label printed at your weighing counter, CB POS instantly identifies the product, enters `1.250 kg` into the quantity column, and multiplies it by your per-kilogram price automatically [E3].

docs.title: Back up and restore
docs.summary: Protecting your business data with AES-256 encrypted backups.
docs.body_md:
# Back up and restore

Because CB POS is offline-first, your sales, inventory, and accounting data reside safely on your local computer's drive [G2]. To protect against hardware failure or accidental damage, regular backups are essential.

## Automated Backups

- **Shift Close Prompt:** When a cashier closes their register shift, CB POS prompts to take an encrypted backup [G2].
- **App Close Auto-Backup:** In **Settings** › **Backup & Security**, you can set a master backup password and choose a backup directory (such as a USB pen drive or external hard drive). CB POS will then create an encrypted `.ZIP` backup automatically every time the software closes [G2].

## Backup Encryption

All CB POS backup archives are compressed and encrypted using AES-256 encryption [G2]. Even if an unauthorized person copies your backup file, they cannot access your financial records without your secret password [G2].

## Restoring on a New Computer

1. Install CB POS on the new computer [A2].
2. On the initial setup screen, choose **Restore from Backup** [G3].
3. Select your `.ZIP` backup file and type your backup password [G3].
4. All your inventory, receipts, customer records, and settings will be restored completely [G3].

docs.title: Multiple tills: LAN Sync vs network mode
docs.summary: Running multiple checkout counters on a local network without cloud servers.
docs.body_md:
# Multiple tills: LAN Sync vs network mode

For busy shops running two or more checkout counters, CB POS offers two distinct multi-till options [G4][H]. Both run entirely on your shop's own local network; neither sends your sales data to Ceylon Byte cloud servers [A8].

## Option 1: LAN Sync (Peer-to-Peer)

In LAN Sync mode, one computer acts as the Main Till and secondary tills sync transactions over local Wi-Fi or Ethernet [H1].

:::callout{type=danger}
**Security Notice:** LAN Sync does not perform TLS certificate validation between machines [H6]. You must use LAN Sync strictly on a private, password-protected shop network that customers cannot connect to [H6].
:::

## Option 2: Shared PostgreSQL Network Mode

For large supermarkets or shops with more than 3 tills, you can configure CB POS to connect directly to a dedicated PostgreSQL database server running on your local premises [H2].

:::callout{type=warn}
**Important Constraints:**
- CB POS local backup files do NOT include database data stored on an external PostgreSQL server [G4]. You must configure independent daily backups for PostgreSQL on your server machine [G4].
- PostgreSQL network mode does not have automatic TLS configuration in the application UI [H6]. Keep your database strictly within your internal LAN.
:::
